title: AgentFlow — Loops
description: Loop launch, dispatch, failure and status spans.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, concat(name, ':', attributes_string['af.outcome']) AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name IN ('loop.launch', 'loop.dispatch') AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['af.loop.fail_kind'] AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'loop.fail' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['af.loop.status'] AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'loop.update_status' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['af.loop.event_type'] AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'loop.event' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'loop.dispatch' AND attributes_string['af.error.reason'] LIKE '%target_offline%' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
